description: Which operand families || takes: any scalar (VARIANT included) beside a string converts to the full-width VARCHAR, while the CONTAINER families (OBJECT, ARRAY) are refused against everything including VARIANT and each other - at compile time, so a view over such a body cannot be created; BINARY joins only BINARY with lengths adding and SATURATING at the 8MB binary maximum, as string concatenation saturates at the 16MB VARCHAR maximum. Converted 1:1 from expressions/ConcatOperandFamilyTest (now retired).
